R7BJ-moose-walk-0001.name: 6.1 km W of La Jolie Butte
R7BJ-moose-walk-0001.pressureWhy: No town, pavement or rec site within 1 km and not behind a closure (estimate).
R7BJ-moose-walk-0001.parkWhat: pull off on an unnamed gravel road

evidence.t: 22 wetlands within 2 km; nearest 29.4 ha, right here.
Burn from 2018 (fire G90544), 50 m S: browse.
Black bear: young cutblocks and burns grow berries in late summer and fall (Tip).

seasonRows.cls: Spike fork, tripalm or 10 point bulls
seasonRows.notes: Bag 1. 7-43 portion only (LEH Synopsis map 7P, printed green); portion of 7-51 closed (Map H32); 7-52 portion only (LEH Synopsis map 7R)
LEH (Limited Entry Hunting): draw only, not a general open season

plan: Drive: from Northern Rockies Regional Municipality, about 101 km (straight line times 1.3, estimate).
Park: 59.68471, -124.01786, pull off on an unnamed gravel road. Map links below.
Walk: 410 m N, cross country, no trail mapped. Climb about 0 m, about 8 min at 3 km/h.
Hunt: moose, Sept, Oct (season rows). Glass the wetland and cutblock edges at dawn and dusk. Move slowly, stop often (Tip). Also: black bear (see evidence).
Use: .308 Winchester, 165 to 180 grain premium bullet, shots inside about 200 m (219 yd) (Tip).

Legal: MU (Management Unit) 7-53, Region 7B. Season: moose spike fork, tripalm or 10 point bulls Sept 1 to Oct 31 and more rows (synopsis page 62, 99%). 1 legal flag below. Study aid only. The official regulations are the law.
Verify: Candidate, scout it first. Check posted signs. Private land can be unsigned. Data dates: roads 2026-10-16, private land 2023-09-20, closures 2026-10-16.
R7BJ-moose-walk-0001.popWhy: Less popular (quieter): MU 7-53: about 130 hunter days a year for moose (2020 to 2024 mean), 0.01 days per square km, bottom third of BC MUs; access: average access. Estimate, about 50% sure (my pick).

tags.label: Good for 2
tags.why: Cover edge here (cutblock or burn): one hunter sits at a crossing or glasses, the other walks the edge slowly with the wind at their back toward the stander. Agree zones of fire, a meeting point and a time at the truck (Tip, lesson: Hunting with a partner). Pushes are on foot only (99%, synopsis page 11, item 25).

tags.label: Good solo
tags.why: Short pack out: 0.4 km and about 0 m of climb from the parking (Tip). Cell coverage is not in the data: leave a trip plan and carry SOS or a satellite messenger (lesson: Bush safety).
